translate_en|mods/DrinkSmart/42.15/media: If enabled, the Drink Smart submenu adds a Sip option after All, 1/2, or 1/4. It drinks the smallest practical amount: about 0.01 L, or all remaining liquid if less.
Allow drinking water when not thirsty
If enabled, water sources show the Drink menu even when Thirst is below 10%% (inventory, containers, and floor panel).
If enabled, the 0%% Thirst option shows the estimated liquid amount that will be consumed, based on the container's current amount.
